comment: M02 golden-slice art review. Eye-height spectator views of every room on the authored route, with the guards that are placed from the start (guard room and ward) in their rooms. Look at each still against docs/design/earth.md, the art bible and the Recall Notice bar; this is art review, not combat or fresh-player evidence.
